messages:
Maya: Quick sanity-check — the Eng↔Product sync is getting noisy and a few teams asked to change cadence. Proposing we switch to 45-min biweekly (odd weeks = roadmap/decisions, even weeks = RFCs/design reviews). Who can own agendas for the next 3 meetings?
Liam: I can own the first one (odd week). Prefer Tue 11am — avoids infra standups.
Ash: If we go biweekly, can we add a short 5-min decision-log review at the top? So outcomes are recorded immediately.
Rita: I can take the RFC/design review meeting (even week). Will collect RFCs 48h in advance.
Sam: +1 for decision-log check. Also want to flag PR #4523 (auth sharding) — needs eng eyes before design review.
Maya: Cool. Agenda template draft below — <@deploy-bot> can you create a recurring invite for the biweekly slot and include this?
Maya: ```Agenda template (45m):
- 0-5m: Decision-log review (owner)
- 5-20m: Roadmap updates / blockers (product owners)
- 20-35m: Deep dive (RFC or design)
- 35-40m: Action items & owners
- 40-45m: Quick follow-ups / parking-lot
```
Liam: Works for me. If any RFC needs >15m deep dive, mark as "deep-dive" and we'll triage separately.
Rita: I'll collect RFCs in this thread. Please paste a 2-line TL;DR + desired outcome. I'll make a slot list by EOD Fri.
Sam: TL;DR for PR #4523: "split auth table to reduce lock contention". Outcome: decide on migration approach (rolling vs maintenance window).
Ash: Action: Maya -> add decision log entry for API-123 (auth-scheme) before next odd-week sync.
Maya: Added to my todo.
deploy-bot: Created recurring biweekly event "Eng-Product Sync (45m)" starting Tue 2026-10-06 11:00 UTC. Invite sent to: Maya, Liam, Ash, Rita, Sam. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abc123
Liam: Quick ask — can reviewers ping in PR description with the label "ready-for-sync" so Rita can slot it? Saves us back-and-forth.
Rita: Yes please. If you put "ready-for-sync" and a suggested duration (10/20/30m) I'll prioritize.
Sam: Done — updated PR #4523 with label + suggested 20m.
Maya: One more: rotation for agenda ownership — current proposal: (1) Liam, (2) Rita, (3) Ash repeat. Sound fair?
Liam: Fine with that.
Ash: Fine.
Rita: Fine. Also: can product bring 1 metric and 1 customer ask to roadmap segments. Keeps it focused.
Maya: Will do.
Sam: Small follow-up — can someone from infra confirm whether the new cadence affects our deployment blackout windows? @Ash?
Ash: Infra blackout windows unchanged for now. If any deep-dive needs maintenance window we'll coordinate separately.
Maya: Great — thanks all. I'll post the first agenda doc in this thread by EOD and add owners to the calendar invite.
Liam: Thanks — I'll ping eng leads for any blockers before the meeting. :thumbsup:
Rita: If no objections I'll lock the rotation and agenda template by Friday.
Maya: No objections. Locking it in. :lock:
